jobs.title: Founding Product Manager (EU/UK Based - Remote)
jobs.description:
ABOUT DUVO http://Duvo.ai

Enterprise teams still copy data between systems all day. Work gets stuck in emails, legacy UIs, and handoffs. That chaos is costly, slow, and risky.

We're a fast-moving team on a mission to end it for good. Traction is strong, and we're solving real problems for real customers – but to win, we need exceptional talent. We stay humble, do the work, and let results speak.

We're building the post-RPA Agentic Automation Platform for enterprises – a horizontal platform where AI agents execute end-to-end work across UIs and APIs with governance built in. Where copilots stop, duvo finishes the job. Business users specify the outcome; agents plan, act, request approvals on exceptions, and learn with every run.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Manager to own core parts of the Duvo platform – the durable, repeatable primitives that let AI agents execute end-to-end work for enterprises.

You'll sit close to our enterprise customers, absorb every ask and every piece of noise, and translate it into platform capabilities that scale across all customers — one product, sold many times.

This is a senior IC role, reporting directly to the Head of Product, with full ownership of your platform areas. Strategy and deep execution sit in the same seat.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own core areas of the platform end-to-end, from discovery through shipped product

 - Translate messy, customer-specific asks into abstract, durable base entities in the platform

 - Build with AI and agent leverage as a default part of your product process

 - Sit with customers in the field to gather first-hand insight

 - Drive both strategy and hands-on execution, owning outcomes alongside engineering and design

 - Help shape the product surface as Duvo expands across industries and enterprise functions
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You'll be someone who:

 - Knows the enterprise deeply: You've been exposed to enterprise customers up close — ideally at an earlier-stage startup selling into enterprises, or inside an enterprise driving innovation projects around AI agents, automation, or related. You understand what enterprise-grade means in practice: RBAC, security reviews, on-prem constraints, privacy, and procurement quirks. No specific industry preference.

 - AI-native and high-agency: You've worked hands-on with AI agents, automation, or agentic workflows — you use AI in your daily work and have a clear point of view on where agent-native products are heading. We'll take agency and AI-nativeness over years of domain depth.

 - Has zero-to-one instincts: You've helped take a product from nothing to its first customers, or built something new inside an existing organisation.

 - Lives in the weeds: Strong IC who thrives on owning end-to-end cycles. You enjoy strategy, but also love deep execution work.

 - Translates field to product: You can sit with a customer, absorb the noise, and come back with the abstracted product primitive that scales.

 - Operates customer-first: The customer's voice inside the product team, and the product team's voice on the ground.

 - Thrives in ambiguity: You're comfortable with direct, no-nonsense communication and make progress without a playbook.

Required:

 - Deep exposure to enterprise customers at an enterprise-focused startup, or inside an enterprise on innovation, AI agent, or automation projects

 - Hands-on experience with AI agents, automation, or agentic workflows

 - 3–5+ years as a PM at a B2B product company or startup – we'll value agency and AI-nativeness over years in seat.

 - A track record of shipped outcomes you can point to, with metrics attached

 - Comfort owning both strategy and deep, hands-on execution

 - Some demonstrated zero-to-one experience

Nice to have:

 - Engineering background or technical fluency

 - Experience building horizontal platform products — automation, integration, or developer platforms

 - Earlier-stage startup experience (seed to Series B)
   
   


HOW WE WORK

 - Customer-obsessed: we solve real problems, not hypothetical ones.

 - Iterative by default: we ship small, learn fast, and don't get attached to yesterday's code.

 - AI-first leverage: we use AI to move faster and focus human time where it matters most.

 - Frontier-aligned: our mission follows where frontier AI labs are heading.

 - Direct feedback, low ego: clear, actionable feedback so we can grow fast.

Remote across Europe, with monthly travel to Prague for in-person collaboration.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - A sharp, motivated team that values ownership and candor

 - The chance to shape both product and culture while working on cutting-edge AI challenges

 - Real impact: Your work will ship to customers and move the business

 - Competitive equity and compensation
